title: Book a wheelchair accessible taxi
summary: Book a wheelchair accessible taxi online through the Wheelchair Book & Ride service in the Sydney metropolitan area.
intro: Wheelchair Book & Ride is a booking service for wheelchair accessible taxis in the Sydney metropolitan area. If you are unable to access public transport because you use a wheelchair, you can book a wheelchair accessible taxi online.
who_can_apply: Use a wheelchair and are unable to access public transport.
what_you_need: Number of wheelchair passengers and additional passengers

how_to_steps.text: Fill out the online form including your contact details, passenger information, pick-up and drop-off addresses and any instructions for the driver.
Select if booking under the Taxi Transport Subsidy Scheme (TTSS).
Select if you would like to receive an SMS notification about your booking.

more_info.text: The taxi bookings and general enquiries phone line on 139 000 is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week
Bookings are accepted subject to availability
You can change or cancel an existing booking online, or over the phone
There are no booking fees when booking
Passengers will pay the driver at the end of the journey
The booking service is only available in the Sydney metropolitan area. Contact your local taxi service operator for trips outside of Sydney.
You can use the Taxi Transport Subsidy Scheme for the Wheelchair Book & Ride service.
If you would like to provide feedback on the booking service, please complete the Wheelchair Book & Ride feedback form.

faqs.q: How far in advance can I book a wheelchair accessible taxi?
faqs.a: You can book up to 28 days in advance.

faqs.q: What do I need to book a wheelchair accessible taxi?
faqs.a: You need your details, pick-up and drop-off addresses, booking time, the number of wheelchair and additional passengers, and any instructions for the driver.

faqs.q: Can I book a wheelchair accessible taxi if I need a subsidy?
faqs.a: You can select if you are booking under the Taxi Transport Subsidy Scheme (TTSS) during the online booking process.
